Security and trust

Agent guidance is not access control.

Use metric views for deterministic calculations, Unity Catalog privileges and policies for enforcement, trusted assets for reviewed complex answers, and benchmarks for natural-language regression. Hiding a field or writing an instruction cannot secure data.
